# PLAN — iteration 2
## Current state assessment
Iteration 1 is the verified best: it combines the dividend and quotient shift state, reducing LUTs to 67 and FFs to 74 while passing simulation and setup/hold timing. The current seed retains a 32-bit `iteration_count`; its value only ranges from `WIDTH-1` to zero for supported `WIDTH` values 1–16, so much of the counter and its decrement/zero-detect logic may be unnecessary.

## Hypothesis
Sizing the iteration counter to the supported `WIDTH` range will reduce counter logic and may lower LUT use while preserving the exact compute schedule.

## Instruction for generator
Replace the 32-bit `iteration_count` with an unsigned counter sized to represent `0` through `WIDTH-1` (use at least one bit for `WIDTH=1`), and update its reset, load, decrement, and zero comparison consistently. Keep the load at `WIDTH-1` on request capture and preserve the final iteration and result publication on the existing edge. Retain the combined quotient shift register, the top’s `// @latency 9` annotation, and all existing handshake, held-result, reset, and parameter behavior.
